# Toggle Button

> One button that stays pressed until it's pressed again, for a setting that's on or off.

`<slab-toggle-button>` · Selection · built on `<button aria-pressed>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/toggle-button/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/toggle-button.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-toggle-button label="Mute">
  <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16">
    <path d="M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4z" fill="currentColor" />
  </svg>
</slab-toggle-button>
```

For a setting that's applied as soon as it changes, such as a preference, a Switch reads more clearly. For a row of these, such as Bold, Italic and Underline, use Toggle Group, so Tab reaches them once and the arrow keys move between them.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Enter, Space | Presses the button, or releases it, as on a `<button>`. |

## Elements

### `<slab-toggle-button>`

Import `slab-elements/toggle-button.js` to register it.

A toggle button with no visual styles, around a native `<button>` with `aria-pressed`, for one setting that's on or off, such as Bold or Mute.

A click, Space or Enter presses it or releases it, and dispatches "input" and "change". Setting `pressed` doesn't dispatch either. A click your own capturing handler cancels doesn't press anything.

Its name is what's slotted into it. Set `label` when that doesn't name it, such as when it holds only an icon, and keep the label the same whether it's pressed or not: `aria-pressed` already says which it is. A label that flips from "Mute" to "Unmute" is read as "Unmute, pressed", which says the opposite. For several buttons that belong together, use Toggle Group, so Tab reaches them once.

Style it through its part and `:state(pressed)`.

#### Attributes

| Name       | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                                |
| `label`    | `string`  |         | Names the button when what's in it doesn't, such as when it holds only an icon.                                                                              |
| `pressed`  | `boolean` | `false` | Like a native checkbox's `checked`, the attribute is the default state and the property is the current one. Style `:state(pressed)` rather than `[pressed]`. |

#### Methods

| Signature                             | Description                                      |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `click(): void`                       | Clicks it, as a native element's `click()` does. |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.  |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                                                                            |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `input`  | `Event` | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.   |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                                             |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The label, plus anything else a design puts in a button |

#### CSS parts

| Name     | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `button` | The button  |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description          |
| ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled. |
| `:state(pressed)`  | While it's pressed.  |
